ai.overview: AS Roma put their lineal championship belt on the line when they host Sassuolo Calcio on November 7, 2026. The belt has already been defended 8 times in Roma's current reign, and this marks the fifth meeting between these sides with the championship at stake. Roma's dominant all-time record against Sassuolo (13-2-9 in 24 meetings) underscores their historical advantage in this matchup.
key_matchups: Roma's recent defensive solidity (4–0, 4–0, 2–0 wins before the Inter draw) against Sassuolo's struggles to keep clean sheets (conceding in all 5 recent games)
Sassuolo's ability to upset top sides (3–2 vs Juventus) versus Roma's home form and 8 successful belt defenses
Roma's unbeaten head-to-head streak in recent meetings (five straight wins dating to March 2023)
ai.betting_angles: Roma enter as clear Elo favorites with strong underlying form: a 4-0-1 record and four wins in their last five before drawing with Inter Milan 2–2. Sassuolo's 2-2-1 mark shows inconsistency, though their 3–2 victory over Juventus demonstrates they can threaten quality opposition. The head-to-head history heavily favors the hosts, with Roma winning 13 of 24 all-time meetings and taking the last five encounters dating back to 2023.
ai.prediction_writeup: Roma should extend their belt reign to 9 defenses based on their superior form and overwhelming head-to-head dominance. While the 2–2 draw with Inter Milan halted a four-game winning streak, Roma's recent home performances (4–0 vs Fiorentina, 2–1 vs Atalanta) suggest they remain formidable at their ground. Sassuolo showed they can score against anyone with that 3–2 win over Juventus, so they'll likely find the net, but Roma have won all five recent meetings including 2–0 and 1–0 results earlier this year. The Elo model backing Roma as clear favorites aligns with both current form and historical precedent in this matchup.
